scope: All ten existing C-port entries with original complete test inputs and official comparators; not unported CPU2017 entries or a reportable SPEC result.

comparator_provenance.note: Each per-entry manifest is an unchanged single-key subset of the original official manifest. Runner and validator use that same subset hash. All ten keys and all 25 comparisons are represented.

evidence.exclusions: Archive excludes staged duplicate inputs, guest disk images and temporary files; retains outputs, serial logs, commands, hashes and comparator reports.

limitations: Single hart and one supervisor slot; no RTL/FPGA or multi-hart qualification.
Existing frozen benchmark binaries reused; this does not qualify a fresh compiler build.
Perl uses the previously qualified provenance-v2 revision07 port and confined shell/null/tmp grants; other entries use their recorded native configuration.
Elapsed host time is diagnostic and not a performance comparison.
